title: eBay Search & Listings

queries.title: Search keywords
queries.description: Keywords, e.g. ["mechanical keyboard"]. Each searches the domain marketplace for pages result pages (up to 60 listings/page, $0.004 each). Returns active search-card rows, without item specifics. Item-page details are currently unreliable; successful search does not guarantee detail rows in another run. For cheapest results, use sortBy "price_low". Sold/completed listings are unsupported. One of queries or startUrls is required.
queries.sectionDescription: Keywords and/or eBay URLs. At least one of the two.

startUrls.title: eBay URLs
startUrls.description: Item-page details are currently unreliable; do not rely on item specifics. Prefer active search URLs, e.g. ["https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=gpu"]. Item URLs remain accepted but may return only error status rows (free); each delivered listing costs $0.004. Search success does not guarantee item-page access. URLs select the marketplace; see domain for supported hosts (UK unsupported). Supported search filters are kept; sold/completed flags are stripped and those modes are unsupported.

domain.title: Marketplace
domain.description: Marketplace for keyword searches: "com" (default), "de", "fr", "it", "es", "nl", "pl", "com.au", "com.sg", "com.my". These are the 10 supported hosts. UK, Ireland, Canada, Switzerland, Hong Kong and Austria are unsupported; passing their URLs does not make them supported. Prices use the currency rendered by eBay, recorded in each row. startUrls chooses the marketplace from each URL instead of this field.

pages.title: Pages per keyword or URL
pages.description: Result pages per keyword or search URL, 1 to 34, e.g. 2 (default 1). Up to 60 listings/page at $0.004 each: at most $0.24/page per keyword or search URL. Set maxResultsPerQuery for a smaller cap. eBay stops paginating at about 2,000 listings. pages does not fetch item-detail pages. Item-page details are currently unreliable; more search pages do not provide item specifics.
pages.sectionDescription: Depth and the cost control: 60 listings a page, $0.004 each.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max listings per keyword or URL
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Listings to deliver per keyword or URL, e.g. 100. 0 (default) = everything the pages returned (60 × pages). N = the first N in eBay's order; fetching stops as soon as a job has N, so 100 with pages 5 reads two pages and bills 100. Use for "give me 50 listings of X". eBay applies minPrice/maxPrice before this count; the actor's own re-check can drop a few more, never charging them.

buyingFormat.title: Buying format
buyingFormat.description: "all" (default) = every listing. "buy_it_now" = fixed-price listings only (eBay's LH_BIN filter; rows carry units sold, watchers, best offer). "auction" = auctions only (LH_Auction; rows carry bids and time left). Applied by eBay, so excluded listings are never fetched or billed. Use "auction" with sortBy "ending_soonest" for "eBay auctions ending soon".
buyingFormat.sectionDescription: Buying format, condition, category and sort are eBay's own URL filters; the price bounds are sent to eBay too and re-checked before billing. A filtered search costs the pages it returns and nothing more.

conditions.title: Item condition
conditions.description: Keep only these conditions, e.g. ["new"] or ["used", "open_box"]. Allowed: new, open_box, certified_refurbished, excellent_refurbished, very_good_refurbished, good_refurbished, seller_refurbished, used, for_parts. Empty (default) = every condition. eBay grades refurbished in four tiers, so list each tier you accept. Applied by eBay (LH_ItemCondition): excluded listings are never fetched or billed.

minPrice.title: Minimum price
minPrice.description: Lowest price to keep, in the marketplace's own currency, e.g. 50. 0 (default) = no minimum. Sent to eBay (_udlo) so the results arrive already filtered, then checked again before billing: a listing under it is never charged.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price
maxPrice.description: Highest price to keep, in the marketplace's own currency, e.g. 200. 0 (default) = no maximum. Sent to eBay (_udhi) and checked again before billing: a listing over it is never charged. Use for "eBay listings under $200".

category.title: Category id
category.description: eBay numeric category id to search inside, e.g. "175672" (computer components) — the _sacat number in any eBay category URL. Empty (default) = all of eBay. Use for "X in the Y category". This filters search results; it does not populate item-page category or breadcrumbs, which are currently unreliable.

sortBy.title: Sort order
sortBy.description: eBay's own order: "best_match" (default), "ending_soonest" (auctions), "newly_listed" (new listings first, for monitoring), "price_low", "price_high" (both price plus shipping, what a shopper compares). Use "price_low" with maxResultsPerQuery for "the 20 cheapest X".

sessions.title: Parallel sessions
sessions.description: Proxy sessions (egress IPs) in parallel, 1 to 16, e.g. 4 (default). More is faster; each is paced separately and warmed on eBay's homepage before its first request. Raise it for long keyword lists.
sessions.sectionDescription: eBay sits behind Akamai and refuses repeat callers; the run detects every refusal, rotates IP and moves to residential proxies on its own.

perIp.title: Requests per second per IP
perIp.description: Requests per second per session, 0.1 to 2, e.g. 0.5 (default). eBay tolerates about 0.5/s per IP; faster earns interstitials, not speed.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy, required — {"useApifyProxy": true} (the default): eBay answers unproxied and unrotated callers with an Akamai interstitial. The run starts on datacentre proxies and switches to RESIDENTIAL by itself when eBay pushes back. Leave the default.

description: eBay active listings. Minimal input: {"queries": ["mechanical keyboard"]} = the first page of ebay.com, up to 60 listings at $0.004 each ($0.24). pages (default 1) decides the bill: pages × 60 × $0.004 per keyword; maxResultsPerQuery caps it exactly. Sold or completed listings are not available (eBay sign-in wall).
